basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old freelance sound designer from Austin, Texas. Passionate about music and soundscapes, I love creating immersive audio experiences. By day, I work from my home studio, which gives me the flexibility to explore my other interests, like collecting Omega watches and staying informed on local politics. I’m single and enjoy casual meet-ups over some good tunes—or perhaps something a little more adventurous. I’m usually online late at night, especially on weekends, when I’m winding down from work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Audio Engineering and several years of experience in the indie game industry, I have honed my skills in creating soundtracks and sound effects. I've also taught myself various music production software, which I use to experiment with different genres and soundscapes.
